vacancies.descEn: Open competitive examination for recruitment to Grade III of the Central Provincial Management Service Officers Service, with 242 vacancies. The post is permanent and pensionable with salary scale MN 02-2025.

vacancies.descEn: The role involves managing monthly welfare benefit payments to nearly two million beneficiaries, preparing payment reports, handling bank account transfers, investigating fraudulent claims, coordinating with district and divisional secretariats, presenting annual financial statistics, and conducting procurement activities.

Internal Candidates: 1) Having obtained the qualifications required by external candidates above. OR 2) Completion of minimum three years satisfactory service in a post in the MM1-1 Category in the subject area relevant to the post.

vacancies.descEn: The General Manager will oversee the operations of Cey-Nor Foundation Limited, a fully government-owned company under the Ministry of Fisheries that manufactures fishing vessels and leisure boats for the fisheries industry and sells fishing equipment. The role requires senior managerial leadership with extensive experience in boat manufacturing, design, and business promotion.
vacancies.salary: HM 1-3 – 2025: Rs. 152,500/- + 15 × Rs. 4,100/- = Rs. 214,000/- (2026 salary: Rs. 133,028/- per Management Services Circular No. 01/2025); Allowances: Cost of Living Allowance Rs. 17,800/-, Professional Allowance Rs. 25,000/-, Fuel Allowance 145 liters, Vehicle Allowance Rs. 50,000/-, Telephone Allowance Rs. 4,250/-
vacancies.qualEn: External Applicants: A First Degree in Engineering / Science / Management / Law / Business Administration / Public Administration or Finance from a UGC-recognized university, together with a Master's Degree or Associate Membership of a recognized professional institution, and knowledge and experience in boat manufacturing, boat designing and business promotion.
